gloss: tidying up; putting in order; organizing

definitions.explanation: The act of arranging things neatly in their proper places.

examples.japanese: {部屋|へや}の{整頓|せいとん}をしなさい。
{机|つくえ}の{上|うえ}が{整頓|せいとん}されている。
{整理|せいり}{整頓|せいとん}は{仕事|しごと}の{効率|こうりつ}を{上|あ}げる。
examples.english: Organizing and tidying up improves work efficiency.

notes:
5S IN JAPANESE WORKPLACES:
{整頓|せいとん} is one of the famous "5S" workplace organization principles:
・{整理|せいり} (seiri) - sort
・{整頓|せいとん} (seiton) - set in order
・{清掃|せいそう} (seiso) - shine/clean
・{清潔|せいけつ} (seiketsu) - standardize
・{躾|しつけ} (shitsuke) - sustain

COMMON PAIR:
{整理|せいり}{整頓|せいとん} is often used as a set phrase meaning "organizing and tidying up."

DIFFERENCE FROM {整理|せいり}:
・{整理|せいり} - organizing, sorting (includes discarding unnecessary items)
・{整頓|せいとん} - tidying, arranging (putting things in proper places)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{身|み}の{回|まわ}りの{整頓|せいとん} - organizing one's personal space
・{整頓|せいとん}された{部屋|へや} - a tidy room
